01 · Explore

The living globe iHover a country to inspect it, drag to rotate, click to open its country map. 3D uses an orthographic projection; 2D uses Equal Earth. Colour = the metric you pick, for the selected year. Grey = no data in the sheet.

drag · scroll to zoom · click
2024

iRanking of countries for the chosen metric and year. Hover to highlight on the globe, click to open that country’s map.

02 · Analyse

Every chart, one selection iAll charts share one state: year, metric and country. Click a bar, heat-map cell or the globe and every chart re-draws. Missing values stay as gaps, never as zeros.

Electricity mix treemapiTreemap of electricity generated by each source (TWh) for the selected country and year. Tile area = TWh, so the biggest tile is the dominant source. Hover a tile for its exact value and share.

Top 10iCountries ranked by the chosen metric in the chosen year. Aggregates like “Europe” were removed during cleaning, so only real countries compete.

Violin: share of generation by sourceiEach violin is a kernel-density estimate of the % of a country’s electricity from that source across all countries with data. Wide = many countries. White bar = median; dot = selected country.

Line: renewables share trendirenewables_share_elec by year. With “All countries” it shows the 6 largest generators plus the World (amber). With one country it is compared with the World. Click to jump to a year.

Box plotiBox = middle 50% of yearly values, line = median, whiskers = min/max over 1985–2025. All countries: renewables share per top-10 generator. One country: the share of each energy source over the years.

RadariRadar of how much each source contributes to electricity (% of generation). Teal = selected country, amber = World. A spike toward a corner shows reliance on that source.

Key insightsiAuto-written from the CSV for the selected year: leaders, fastest risers and global change. They update with the year slider.

Heat map: selected metric, top 22 generators × yeariRows are the 22 biggest electricity producers in the selected year; columns are years. Colour = renewables share of electricity. Click any cell to select that country and year.

Data previewiReal rows from the cleaned CSV. All countries: top 25 by renewables share. One country: its latest 25 years. Click a row to select it.

03 · Under the hood

How the data becomes this page

Hover the i badges anywhere for the details.

Data: the supplied Renewable_Energy_World_Wide-energy-data.csv (1985–2025, 214 countries + World). Climate layers in country maps are a latitude-based model for context, not CSV data. Map shapes: Natural Earth via world-atlas. Built with D3.
